_notice: SAMPLE CONFIGURATION -- NOT THE LENDER'S APPROVED POLICY. Home loan: the requirements come from the product checklist (applicant_agent.yaml HOME_LOAN) + the stage rules (CREDIT: property ownership proof); this file adds 6 months of bank statement and the rest as for personal loan.

base._comment: Rules 1, 3, 4, 5, 8: the case's requirements come from the EXISTING document policy engine (app/agents/policy: app/config/policies/<product>.yaml + app/config/stage_requirements.yaml, cumulative through this stage). This file adds only what that engine does not hold.

document_states._comment: How a stored document's recorded state counts. Read from the document record, never re-verified here.

parties._comment: Rule 2. PRIMARY_APPLICANT: the base requirements. CO_APPLICANT: the existing configured co-applicant checklist (applicant_agent.yaml readiness.co_applicant_documents). A role's requirements apply only to parties of that role present on the case.

CO_APPLICANT._comment: The co-applicant is checked on the applicant's own checklist; the property's documents are the case's.

period_and_freshness.reason: SAMPLE: the statement must cover 6 months and end within 45 days.
SAMPLE: the latest salary slip must be for a month ending within 62 days of the evaluation.
An expired identity document cannot satisfy a requirement.

supporting_documents.reason: SAMPLE: an ITR is read with its computation of income.

same_kind._comment: Rule 5. Types a customer may offer for a slot that this policy does NOT accept: reported as not permitted, never counted. SAMPLE list.

display_names._comment: How a slot or document type is written in a reason. Anything not listed is written as lower-case words.

cross_stage._comment: Rule 8. Documents collected at an earlier stage (FOS / CPA) are reused and never asked for again. A type listed in collect_at_stage must be uploaded on or after the case entered this stage; none is listed (business decision 2026-10-21: the bank statement taken at FOS is accepted; RULE-06 still checks that it is recent).

exceptions.reason: SAMPLE mapping: deviation master 'Acceptance of Non-Standards documents as proof for ID/Age/Address' may waive the address proof requirement once APPROVED through the deviation / maker-checker path.

_critical_comment: Critical (blocks underwriting) ONLY when a required document is missing, not of an accepted type, rejected by verification or mismatched (possibly fake), or waits on an exception. Everything else (an old or short statement, a file to re-upload, a document still being verified) is non-critical: the case can move ahead and the customer is asked for it.

file_rules._comment: Rule 11. The stored file itself: real format (read from its bytes) and size. by_type overrides default. SAMPLE limits.

rules._comment: Switch any rule off with false (RULE-10, the audit, cannot be). Also: env DOCS_CREDIT_RULES_OFF=RULE-07,RULE-11
